description: Apply brand token overlays to a brand's canonical source using alias strategy or the supported add/remove/replace subset of RFC 6902. Requires a delta object. apply=true writes source, runs both real token-build stages, and returns before/after SHA256, byte counts and captured build results. The brand as the change would leave it is checked first, as brand.intake validate checks a brand: apply:true writes nothing unless it validates (OODS-V216), and a dry run returns the report. The receipt lists each changed slot. Build failure returns OODS-S019 with the last 40 output lines; source writes remain in place. After the build, the review kit's variables.css holds the CSS variables the build emitted differently, under their selectors. Default dry-run writes no files, directories, transcripts or bundle indexes. Only apply writes its run record. The brands are the brand registry's: the brands folder the token build reads (A and B ship; health lists them). A brand of yours (in OODS_BRANDS_DIR; from npm ~/.oods-foundry/brands) is written and rebuilt there, from npm too. For the brands OODS Foundry ships, the runtime bundle ships the brand source, so apply:false previews from the bundle; there apply:true emits the review kit (snapshots and specimens) without writing source or rebuilding, and the receipt records both steps as skipped. OODS-N020 is returned only when the brand source directory is missing.

brand.description: Target brand identifier. Must name a brand directory under packages/tokens/src/tokens/brands.

delta.description: Alias changes (object) or an array using the supported add/remove/replace subset of RFC 6902 when strategy=patch.

verbosity.description: full includes structured before/after payloads; compact returns summary + hunks only.

strategy.description: Alias strategy rewrites token values; patch applies the supported add/remove/replace subset of RFC 6902.

name: brand_apply
